scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Thomason Model Structures in Every Strict Higher Dimension” (preprints/Thomason-Model-Structures-in-Every-Strict-Higher-Dimension-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 317 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4297861df49692b8), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every n ∈ {1, 2, 3, . . .} ∪ {∞}, the classes (Cn, Wn, Fn) in (1.1) form a proper combinatorial model structure on nCat. It is cofibrantly generated by (LnI, LnJ), where I = {∂∆[m] ↪→ ∆[m] : m ≥ 0}, J = {Λk [m] ↪→ ∆[m] : m ≥ 1, 0 ≤ k ≤ m}. Moreover, Ln : sSetKQ ⇄ (nCat, Cn, Wn, Fn) : Rn is a Quillen equivalence.
